"""Read counters for our own benchmark children, using the installed public macOS ABI.
Header reference: https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/main/bsd/sys/resource.h
"""
import ctypes,os,re
from pathlib import Path
body=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/usr/include/sys/resource.h').read_text().split('struct rusage_info_v4 {',1)[1].split('};',1)[0]
fields=[]
for line in body.splitlines():
 m=re.search(r'uint64_t\s+(\w+);',line)
 if m:fields.append((m[1],ctypes.c_uint64))
 elif 'ri_uuid' in line:fields.append(('ri_uuid',ctypes.c_uint8*16))
class Info(ctypes.Structure):_fields_=fields
lib=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libproc.dylib',use_errno=True)
lib.proc_pid_rusage.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p];lib.proc_pid_rusage.restype=ctypes.c_int

def collect(child):
 os.waitid(os.P_PID,child.pid,os.WEXITED|os.WNOWAIT)
 info=Info();status=lib.proc_pid_rusage(child.pid,4,ctypes.byref(info))
 counters={'instructions':info.ri_instructions,'cycles':info.ri_cycles,'lifetime_peak_footprint_bytes':info.ri_lifetime_max_phys_footprint,'counter_status':status,'counter_errno':ctypes.get_errno() if status else 0}
 _,status,usage=os.wait4(child.pid,0);child.returncode=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
 return counters,usage

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,time,json,ctypes,statistics,hashlib
from rusage_counters import Info,lib,collect
r=Path('/tmp/velocity-r16-review/paired-idle');r.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
# XNU task_power_info_locked / fill_task_rusage expose CPU time in Mach ticks:
# https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/main/osfmk/kern/task.c#L6367
# https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/main/osfmk/kern/bsd_kern.c#L1187
class Timebase(ctypes.Structure): _fields_=[('numer',ctypes.c_uint32),('denom',ctypes.c_uint32)]
clocklib=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib');timebase=Timebase()
clocklib.mach_timebase_info.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(Timebase)]
assert clocklib.mach_timebase_info(ctypes.byref(timebase))==0
rows=[]
def sample(pid):
 info=Info(); status=lib.proc_pid_rusage(pid,4,ctypes.byref(info))
 assert status==0,status
 return dict(user_ticks=info.ri_user_time,system_ticks=info.ri_system_time,instructions=info.ri_instructions,cycles=info.ri_cycles,resident_bytes=info.ri_resident_size,footprint_bytes=info.ri_phys_footprint,at=time.monotonic())
for pair in range(7):
 for label in (['main','candidate']if pair%2==0 else ['candidate','main']):
  binary=r.parent/('probe-'+label)
  with (r/f'{pair+1}-{label}.log').open('w')as f:
   child=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),'--ignored','--exact','view::round16_perf::hot_scenes','--nocapture'],env=dict(os.environ,R16_PERF_IDLE='1'),stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   time.sleep(.5);before=sample(child.pid)
   time.sleep(2);after=sample(child.pid)
   counters,usage=collect(child)
   assert child.returncode==0,child.returncode
  row=dict(pair=pair+1,label=label,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),before=before,after=after,steady_cpu_ms=((after['user_ticks']-before['user_ticks'])+(after['system_ticks']-before['system_ticks']))*timebase.numer/timebase.denom/1e6,steady_wall_ms=(after['at']-before['at'])*1000,user_s=usage.ru_utime,system_s=usage.ru_stime,maxrss_bytes=usage.ru_maxrss,**counters)
  row['steady_cpu_percent']=row['steady_cpu_ms']/row['steady_wall_ms']*100
  rows.append(row)
  print(pair+1,label,row['steady_cpu_ms'],flush=True)
summary={}
for key in ['steady_cpu_ms','steady_cpu_percent','maxrss_bytes']:
 a,b=[statistics.median(x[key]for x in rows if x['label']==label)for label in ['main','candidate']]
 summary[key]=dict(main=a,candidate=b,delta_pct=(b/a-1)*100)
(r/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(pairs=7,timebase=dict(numer=timebase.numer,denom=timebase.denom),window='Own-child CPU counters from 0.5 to 2.5 seconds after launch; setup excluded. Existing idle probe/binaries unchanged.',rows=rows,summary=summary),indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,shutil,os,re,hashlib
r=Path('/tmp/velocity-r16-review2');repo=Path.cwd();base=Path('/tmp/velocity-r16-review/main')
for name in ['probe-main','probe-candidate']:
 shutil.copy2(r/name,r/(name+'-before-real-probe'))

env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(repo/'target'))
log=r/'real-probe-main-build.log'
with log.open('w')as f:
 status=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','velocity','--release','--locked','--no-run'],cwd=base,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
assert status==0,log.read_text()[-6000:]
artifact=re.search(r'Executable unittests src/main.rs \(([^)]+)\)',log.read_text())
assert artifact,log.read_text()
path=Path(artifact[1]);path=path if path.is_absolute()else base/path
shutil.copy2(path,r/'probe-main')
# The temporary baseline shares the dependency cache; force the changed current
# sources to be reconsidered before building the candidate. No content changes.
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
for name in files:
 p=repo/name
 if p.suffix=='.rs':p.touch()
log=r/'real-probe-candidate-build.log'
with log.open('w')as f:
 status=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','velocity','--release','--locked','--no-run'],cwd=repo,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
assert status==0,log.read_text()[-6000:]

assert artifact,log.read_text();shutil.copy2(repo/artifact[1],r/'probe-candidate')
